candidates.description: This feature activates on words, roots, and proper nouns related to South Asian religions, philosophies, and geography.
German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, or tense.
This vector is related to common German grammatical words and conjunctions.
This vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
This feature vector represents linguistic tokens and subword fragments containing the letters "at" or related variations.
This feature vector activates on common German noun prefixes, past participle prefixes, and word roots, particularly those starting with "Ge-".
This feature vector activates strongly on common German auxiliary verbs, inflectional suffixes, and grammatical morphemes.
This feature vector activates on German words and prefixes starting with the letter sequence "ver-".
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the suffix '-ed' or variations of proper nouns and nicknames starting with this phonetic ending.
These tokens function as German indefinite and demonstrative determiners, pronouns, or negation particles that inflect for grammatical case, gender, and number.
